result.title: Identifying Dependent Components from Multi-domain Linear Mixtures
result.summary: We study a linear mixing model with dependent latent components, assuming multiple data domains. Most existing models assume that the components are independent or at least uncorrelated, in line with independent component analysis (ICA). Some recent work allows for dependent components, but then makes specific assumptions such as parametric forms of dependencies, multi-view settings, or interventions, or does not recover the individual components. In contrast, we consider a multi-domain setting in which domains differ through domain-specific scalings of the components, while the distribution of the underlying latent components is the same across domains. This approach can model data collected, for example, from different sensors measuring the same process, different laboratories conducting the same experiment, different experimental conditions, or different subjects that might differ in biological or physiological factors. We show that, under sufficient domain variability, latent variables and mixing functions can be identified from second-order statistics alone. We propose the Multi-Domain Covariance Matching (MuDo-CoM) algorithm that generalizes previous methods of joint diagonalization. MuDo-CoM is validated on simulated data and a real-world fMRI dataset.

AI.brief_summary: 研究多域线性混合模型中依赖隐成分的可辨识性：各域仅对成分做域特定缩放而隐分布相同，证明在足够域变异下仅凭二阶统计量即可辨识隐变量与混合函数，提出 MuDo-CoM 协方差匹配算法（推广联合对角化），并在模拟数据与 fMRI 数据上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 VLM/LVR 无直接关联，但其关于「依赖隐成分在跨域尺度变化下仍可辨识」的条件与协方差匹配做法，可能为核查内部状态中视觉成分是否可分离、以及跨域或跨层 latent 相似度中内容与结构因素的可辨识性提供形式化参照，可供核查。
